name: Apply 5-Star filter where no such hotels exist
fullName: MakeMyTrip Hotel Booking - Positive and Negative Scenarios: Apply 5-Star filter where no such hotels exist

steps.name: Given User launches MakeMyTrip application
When User closes the initial login popup
And User navigates to the Hotels section
When User searches for a remote destination from "guest_date.csv"
And User clicks on the Search button
And User closes any promotional popup if present on the results page
And User applies the 5-Star filter
Then A "No hotels found" or "Clear filters" message should be displayed
